newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Communists pledge to back govt in Tues vote.
newsitem.headline: Italy Communists pledge to back govt in Tues vote.

text.p: Communist Refoundation will back the Italian government in a confidence vote later on Tuesday on a package of budget measures introduced at the end of last year, party leader Fausto Bertinotti said.

Speaking to reporters after an early morning meeting with Prime Minister Romano Prodi, Bertinotti repeated that his party was against plans to launch a fresh budget package in the coming days, but said he was prepared to talk about the proposals.
